+"""Test propagation of an active SQL role to EXECUTE STATEMENT ON EXTERNAL."""
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import uuid
+
+
+def run(argv, sql, timeout=90):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        argv,
+        input=sql,
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        timeout=timeout,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def sql_string(value):
+    return "'" + value.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+
+
+def main():
+    dsn = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN")
+    if not dsn:
+        raise RuntimeError("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN is required")
+
+    isql = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ISQL", "isql")
+    admin = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER", "SYSDBA")
+    admin_password = os.environ.get(
+        "ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_" + admin.upper(), "masterkey"
+    )
+    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10].upper()
+    user = "AC_EXT_ROLE_USER_" + suffix
+    user_password = "ext_role_" + suffix.lower()
+    role = "AC_EXT_READ_ROLE_" + suffix
+    table = "AC_EXT_ROLE_DATA_" + suffix
+    procedure = "AC_EXT_ROLE_READ_" + suffix
+    external_dsn = sql_string(dsn)
+    admin_cmd = [isql, "-user", admin, "-password", admin_password, dsn]
+
+    setup_sql = (
+        "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+        f"CREATE USER {user} PASSWORD {sql_string(user_password)};\n"
+        f"CREATE ROLE {role};\n"
+        f"CREATE TABLE {table} (ID INTEGER, SECRET_VALUE INTEGER);\n"
+        f"INSERT INTO {table} VALUES (1, 42);\n"
+        f"GRANT SELECT ON {table} TO ROLE {role};\n"
+        f"GRANT {role} TO USER {user};\n"
+        "COMMIT;\n"
+        "SET TERM ^;\n"
+        f"CREATE PROCEDURE {procedure} RETURNS (VALUE_OUT INTEGER) AS "
+        "BEGIN EXECUTE STATEMENT "
+        + sql_string(f"SELECT SECRET_VALUE FROM {table} WHERE ID = 1")
+        + " ON EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE "
+        + external_dsn
+        + " INTO :VALUE_OUT; SUSPEND; END^\n"
+        "SET TERM ;^\n"
+        f"GRANT EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE {procedure} TO USER {user};\n"
+        "COMMIT;\n"
+    )
+    setup = run(admin_cmd, setup_sql)
+    if setup.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Could not create the external role fixture: "
+            + setup.stdout
+            + setup.stderr
+        )
+
+    no_role = run(
+        [isql, "-user", user, "-password", user_password, dsn],
+        "SET BAIL ON;\n" + f"SELECT SECRET_VALUE FROM {table} WHERE ID = 1;\n",
+    )
+    control_passed = no_role.returncode != 0
+    if not control_passed:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Negative control unexpectedly selected the role-protected table: "
+            + no_role.stdout
+            + no_role.stderr
+        )
+
+    try:
+        target = run(
+            [
+                isql,
+                "-user",
+                user,
+                "-password",
+                user_password,
+                "-role",
+                role,
+                dsn,
+            ],
+            "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+            + f"SELECT CASE WHEN VALUE_OUT = 42 THEN 'EXTERNAL_ROLE_OK' "
+            + f"ELSE 'EXTERNAL_ROLE_BAD' END FROM {procedure};\n",
+        )
+    finally:
+        cleanup_sql = (
+            "SET BAIL OFF;\n"
+            f"DROP PROCEDURE {procedure};\n"
+            f"REVOKE {role} FROM USER {user};\n"
+            f"REVOKE SELECT ON {table} FROM ROLE {role};\n"
+            f"DROP ROLE {role};\n"
+            f"DROP TABLE {table};\n"
+            f"DROP USER {user};\n"
+            "COMMIT;\n"
+        )
+        run(admin_cmd, cleanup_sql, timeout=60)
+
+    passed = target.returncode == 0 and "EXTERNAL_ROLE_OK" in target.stdout
+    result = {
+        "checks": [
+            {
+                "name": "active_role_is_passed_to_external_statement",
+                "kind": "target",
+                "passed": passed,
+                "expected": {"success": True, "stdout_contains": "EXTERNAL_ROLE_OK"},
+                "actual": {
+                    "returncode": target.returncode,
+                    "stdout": target.stdout,
+                    "stderr": target.stderr,
+                },
+            }
+        ],
+        "reproduced": not passed,
+        "origin": "generated_from_issue_reproduction_and_role_propagation_fix",
+    }
+    print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        print("TEST_INFRA_ERROR=" + str(exc), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        sys.exit(2)

+-- Conceptual SQL for the custom test.py external role propagation scenario.
+CREATE USER AC_EXT_ROLE_USER_<suffix> PASSWORD '<temporary-password>';
+CREATE ROLE AC_EXT_READ_ROLE_<suffix>;
+CREATE TABLE AC_EXT_ROLE_DATA_<suffix> (ID INTEGER, SECRET_VALUE INTEGER);
+INSERT INTO AC_EXT_ROLE_DATA_<suffix> VALUES (1, 42);
+GRANT SELECT ON AC_EXT_ROLE_DATA_<suffix> TO ROLE AC_EXT_READ_ROLE_<suffix>;
+GRANT AC_EXT_READ_ROLE_<suffix> TO USER AC_EXT_ROLE_USER_<suffix>;
+
+-- Procedure body uses ON EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE '<ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN>' with
+-- no AS USER, PASSWORD or ROLE clauses, then selects SECRET_VALUE into output.
+-- Target attaches AC_EXT_ROLE_USER_<suffix> with active role
+-- AC_EXT_READ_ROLE_<suffix>; the external SELECT must inherit that role.

+REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS = ['active_role_is_passed_to_external_statement']

+EXPECTED_FILES = {'case_body.py': 'cbf14247b9d481cd1f95ad597e1afd7aa413c8a470523a65ef614120b71764aa', 'record.json': 'd6c4be33915bfbed6db174fcee634ea2a4ea8fa45c579d845c81fe2e742dd0eb', 'scenario.json': '052321139cfe4bb3e0352dab0afe2978f00b6e9dfa5cc0e9ef43c4cf45c7000b', 'scenario.sql': '31875084ef45f7bcfbbe37b1a4541edba73c2a3bd320a5df408667bf4e603b32'}
+
+
+def error(reason, **details):
+    print('CHECK_RESULT=' + json.dumps({

+        'harness_error': reason, 'required_check_ids': REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS,

+def main():

+    for name, digest in EXPECTED_FILES.items():

+            return error('CASE_TEST_ASSET_MISMATCH', asset=name)
+    scenario = json.loads((folder / 'scenario.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

+        return error('SCENARIO_INSTANCE_MISMATCH')
+    if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder':

problem_statement:
ROLE not passed in EXECUTE STATEMENT ... ON EXTERNAL [CORE5898]

Submitted by: Emil Totev (emilt)

The current role is not passed to the external data source when using 'execute statement \.\.\. on external' without AS USER, PASSWORD and ROLE additions\. 
This has been acknowledged as a bug and fixed for 2\.5\.3 \(see [CORE4054](https://github.com/FirebirdSQL/firebird/issues?q=CORE4054+in%3Atitle) \), but the fix is not ported forward to version 3\.

Commits: FirebirdSQL/firebird@79d16e667dc738df6ecddff9ab1d5bfe43ae0dc6 FirebirdSQL/firebird@b0ab147b2749d242bd1397212dd468029eee867f

====== Test Details ======

See also test for [CORE4054](https://github.com/FirebirdSQL/firebird/issues?q=CORE4054+in%3Atitle)\.
